summary: Close mailbox channel loss faults when their incarnation ends

replay.detail: Authenticated replay and native delivery recovery remain unchanged.

rules.detail: Reconciliation resolves mailbox-channel-lost failures for the exact stopped, suspended or exited incarnation with reason incarnation-ended. Other incarnations and unrelated failures stay open.

compatibility.detail: Existing fault readers consume the durable recovery claims.

downtime.detail: No migration or downtime is required.

recovery.detail: Unchanged terminal runtime observations also close retained channel loss faults after an upgrade.
